title: langchain==1.4.0a2
description: Alpha preview of langchain.mcp — a first-party adapter that turns any MCP server into LangChain tools you can hand straight to create_agent . Connection handling is FastMCP 's, so its client features are available as-is rather than re-implemented behind a narrower interface. pip install " langchain[mcp]==1.4.0a2 " Connect MCPAdapter takes any target fastmcp.Client accepts — transport is inferred, so there is one entry point rather than one per protocol. from langchain . agents import create_agen
